welcome_onboarding:
*Hello!* 👋

Welcome to *ExpenseBot*. I will help you track your expenses and income directly from WhatsApp.

Before we start, may I know your name?
onboarding_budget_prompt:
Nice to meet you, *{{name}}*! 👋

What is your planned monthly budget? (Example: "500k" or "5.000.000")

Type *skip* if you want to skip this.
onboarding_completed:
Awesome, *{{name}}*! 🎉 Registration complete.

Now you can start logging expenses, for example:
- "Coffee 25k"
- "Salary 10m"
help_menu_unsupported: I'm not sure what you mean. Here are some things I can help you with:
help_logging:
*1️⃣ Logging (Income/Expense)*
Just type naturally, example:
• _"Coffee 25k"_
• _"Salary 5 million"_
help_reports:
*2️⃣ Financial Reports*
Ask for your balance summary, example:
• _"Expenses today"_
• _"This week's report"_ 
• _"What's my remaining budget?"_
help_footer: Please choose one of the options above or type your question! 📈💸
budget_status_no_limit: You haven't set a monthly budget limit yet.
budget_status_encouragement: Keep up the good work managing your finances! 💪
budget_update_success: ✅ Your monthly budget has been updated to *{{amount}}*.
budget_update_footer: Type "Check budget" to see your usage status.
group_welcome:
*Hello Everyone!* 👋

I am *ExpenseBot*, your expense tracking assistant.

Type messages like:
- "Coffee 25k"
- "Salary 5m"
- "What is today's expense?"

I will track expenses for *this Group*.
group_limit_reached: ⚠️ Sorry, this group can't be tracked. Each user can manage up to *{max} groups*. Please leave this bot from your other groups or contact the owner.
error_generic: Oops! I'm having trouble understanding that. Could you try rephrasing your sentence?
error_budget_parse: I couldn't quite catch the amount. Could you please specify it clearly (e.g., '500k') or type 'skip' to do it later?
